description: Guard-hook wiring for the cla plugin. Every command clears PYEXE, sources hooks/probe-python.sh, and then asserts the postcondition it actually needs — [ -x "$PYEXE" ] — before running its dispatcher. That script's header carries the rationale for BOTH halves: the probe itself, and the shape of the wiring around it. Read it before changing anything here.

hooks.command: PYEXE=; _cla_probe="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/probe-python.sh"; [ -r "$_cla_probe" ] && . "$_cla_probe"; [ -x "$PYEXE" ] || { echo "cla: interpreter probe at $_cla_probe is missing or unusable — guard hooks are NOT running" >&2; exit 1; }; "$PYEXE" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch-edit-write-pretooluse.py"
